name: wechat
description: Multi-channel AI messaging bridge — connect Codex to WeChat (微信) and Feishu/Lark (飞书). Supports text, images, files, voice, video, and remote permission relay via ACP protocol.

interface.shortDescription: Chat with AI via WeChat or Feishu
interface.longDescription: Multi-channel AI messaging bridge supporting WeChat (微信) and Feishu/Lark (飞书). Send text, images, files, voice, and video messages. Includes access control with pairing, allowlists, and remote permission relay. Works via ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for any AI agent: Codex, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Qwen, Opencode.
defaultPrompt: Scan QR code to connect WeChat
